centralIdea: Do not match meaning; require a DECLARATION and check it deterministically. If HazLenz builds owedFacts with factKeys BEFORE the verifier runs and requires every clarification to BIND to one — or to nominate additively, never instead — coverage becomes closed-set membership over declarations. The residual semantic question shrinks from 'does this text mean that fact?' to 'was this declaration truthful?', which is human sampling, not a scorer. Applied to §163, silent displacement becomes structurally impossible.

reliabilityDecomposition.R1_execution: 20/20 clean in §163 — 0 truncation, 0 degenerate, 0 transport failure, 0 forbidden fields. NOT the current problem; adding more execution reliability would address nothing measured.
reliabilityDecomposition.R2_decision: HS-E1 8/10 settled silence. Primary failure. Partially addressable by repetition.
reliabilityDecomposition.R3_targetCoverage: HS-A1 7/10 displaced. Primary failure. NOT addressable by repetition — every draw resamples a distribution that already prefers the other fact.
reliabilityDecomposition.doNotCollapse: §163's 4/20 is the sum of two unrelated failures and is not actionable as one number.

policyC.knownDeliberateGap: a wrong-fact first draw does NOT trigger a second draw; that case is R3 and is handled by coverage, not repetition
policyC.twoNoDrawsRule: TWO SILENCES NEVER ESTABLISH CORRECTNESS. The draws are two samples from one distribution measured to be centred on silence (8/10 on HS-E1); two silences is the most likely outcome (~64%) whether or not silence is correct. Agreement between samples from a biased distribution is evidence about the mode, not the truth. Two silences record SETTLED_SILENCE with drawCount 2, never upgrade to VERIFIED_AS_IS, never mark an owed fact COVERED, and never clear a TARGET_COVERAGE_WARNING.
policyC.observability: both attempts persisted in full under one analysisId with drawIndex 1 and 2; neither replaces the other

owedFacts.theBoundary: Human-authored fixture truth is the standard the system is MEASURED AGAINST. Seeding production owedFacts from it would make it part of the system being measured and destroy the independent scale. Development instrumentation and production architecture share the STRUCTURE and must never share the POPULATION STEP.
owedFacts.modelAuthoredLimit: a production owedFact sourced from model output carries modelAuthored:true and cannot alone justify a fail-closed customer-visible state; it can raise a question, not assert a hazard

deterministic: every LIFE_CRITICAL/REQUIRED_CONTROL fact bound-covered or declared not-decision-critical with a two-branch proof
nomination is additive rather than replacing
no UNRESOLVED→COVERED transition without a binding
notDeterministic: whether the bound question actually answers the fact it bound to
whether a nominated new fact is genuinely decision-critical
semanticMatchingProhibitions: satisfiable by the observation text itself (§160 FINDING 1)
coverageCheck.howBindingAvoidsAllFour: binding never asks a matcher what text means; false bindings are addressed by HUMAN SAMPLING of bound pairs, which is a measurement obligation rather than a runtime component

multiGapPreservation: preserve first and rank second — every LIFE_CRITICAL and REQUIRED_CONTROL fact survives internally regardless of budget
deduplicate only on factKey identity, never on similarity
a gap leaves UNRESOLVED only by evidence or recorded arbitration, never because another gap is more salient
salience is not authority — no path erases an unrelated valid gap
questionBudget: combine only when same affectedDecision, same equipment/task, and both independently answerable without ambiguity
defer only when the answer cannot change what must be done before the next interaction; deferral is recorded, not discarded
NEVER drop a LIFE_CRITICAL gap to fit the budget
fail closed — surface an unresolved safety state rather than a tidy list; deterministic findings still shown

targetCoveragePostcondition.rule: TARGET_COVERAGE_WARNING = TRUE when any LIFE_CRITICAL or REQUIRED_CONTROL owedFact remains UNRESOLVED and no accepted clarification binds its factKey
responses: one bounded verifier re-check naming the uncovered factKeys

stateMachine.breakdown: 1 first pass + 1 degenerate reissue + 2 verifier draws + 1 coverage re-check
stateMachine.invariant: deterministic HazLenz findings are produced and shown under EVERY failure mode; the advisory layer can degrade to nothing without the customer losing the deterministic result

falsifiers.B_owedTargetPreservation: binding available and the verifier still fails to bind or declare on the flame-failure key in >=2 of 6 draws — THE CORE CLAIM FAILS

nextExperiment.decisivePair: B and D — B failing means binding does not solve displacement; D failing means it solves it by manufacturing questions. Neither is detectable from the other.
